info.title: SEF Kopilot API
info.description:
Deterministic validation, plain-language explanations and reviewable repairs for Serbian (SEF)
and EU electronic invoices.

**This service is not a certified validator and is not affiliated with the Serbian Ministry of
Finance or the SEF platform.** By default it only ever talks to the public SEF *demo* environment.

get.description: Reports that the process is up, and whether it is a public demonstration. Never touches external dependencies.
Reports whether this instance can serve traffic. Each dependency is listed under `checks`; as soon as one of them fails the status is `degraded` and the response 503.

503.description: A dependency failed; the instance should not receive traffic.

post.summary: Create an account and its organization
post.description: Creates the account, an organization owned by it, and signs the person in.

429.description: Too many requests; try again after `Retry-After` seconds.

post.description: Checks the e-mail address and password and returns tokens for one organization. A member of several organizations names one in `organization_id`; without it the answer is 409 with the list to choose from.

429.description: Too many requests; try again after `Retry-After` seconds.

post.summary: Join an organization with an invitation code
post.description: Redeems an invitation code: creates the account when the invited address has none, otherwise checks its password, then adds the membership and signs the person in to the organization. A code is good once.

429.description: Too many requests; try again after `Retry-After` seconds.

422.description: The new account's password is too short.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new pair
post.description: Spends the refresh token and returns a new access token and a new refresh token for the same session. A refresh token presented a second time ends the session.

429.description: Too many requests; try again after `Retry-After` seconds.

post.description: Ends the session of the refresh token; an unknown token changes nothing.

429.description: Too many requests; try again after `Retry-After` seconds.

get.description: The person and organization of the access token and the role they hold now; 401 once the account is deactivated or the membership has ended.

post.description: Validates the UBL 2.1 invoice or credit note in the request body against a profile and returns the validator's report. Nothing is stored: the document lives in memory for the length of the request (no-store mode). A document the validator cannot read is a violation in the report, not an error.

408.description: The invoice was not received in time.

413.description: The invoice has more bytes or elements than this server accepts.

422.description: The invoice could not be validated within the time limit, or the rule sets could not be applied to it.

429.description: Too many validations by the caller, or in their organization; try again after `Retry-After` seconds.

503.description: The validator is busy (retry after `Retry-After` seconds) or not available on this server.

requestBody.description: The invoice or credit note, UBL 2.1 XML.

post.description: Validates the invoice in the request body as `POST /invoices/validate` does, then explains each rule its report names: what the rule requires, why the invoice fails it and what to change, citing the passages of the official documents that apply on the invoice's issue date. Every citation is a passage of the corpus this server holds. Each rule is explained once, those that make the invoice invalid first, as many as the server allows in one request; a rule without an explanation says why. Nothing is stored. The language model is sent each rule's first violation, whose message may quote the invoice, and the passages; nothing else of the invoice.

post.description: Starts a job that validates again, with the rules this server has now, the stored invoices the caller may see, as `GET /invoices` lists them, and makes each new report the invoice's latest. `Location` names the job, which `GET /jobs/{job_id}` reads and `GET /jobs/{job_id}/events` follows. A member has one revalidation under way at a time. An invoice whose new report would take the organization past its quota keeps the report it has; the job counts it.

post.description: Explains each rule the stored invoice's latest report names, as `POST /invoices/explain` does for a document in the request body: what the rule requires, why the invoice fails it and what to change, citing the passages of the official documents that apply on the invoice's issue date. The invoice is not validated again: the report explained is the one `GET /invoices/{invoice_id}` reads, and comes with the answer. The language model is sent each rule's first violation, whose message may quote the invoice, and the passages; nothing else of the invoice. Counted as a request to the language model, not as a validation. The explanations are kept with the invoice when every rule asked about is explained, and later requests in the same language read them, asking the model nothing and counting nothing, until the invoice's report is another (`GET /invoices/{invoice_id}/explanations` reads them alone).

post.summary: Propose a repair of a stored invoice
post.description: Applies the patches to a copy of the stored invoice, in order, as `einvoice patch` does, validates what they leave under the invoice's profile, and keeps the repair: what became of each patch, the difference and the report. The invoice itself does not change until a person approves the repair. A patch that touches an amount, VAT, a tax or company identifier, a date or the document's number is not applied: it needs a person's decision. Counted as a validation. `Location` names the repair.

post.summary: Have the language model propose a repair of a stored invoice
post.description: Asks the language model for patches that repair the stored invoice's fatal violations, and keeps them as a repair the caller proposes: the invoice itself does not change until a person approves it. The model is sent the violations, whose messages may quote the invoice, and the invoice's fields around them, by canonical path; nothing else of it. Every answer is checked before anything is applied: each patch at a canonical path, writing no value the model was not given. The patches are applied to a copy and validated, as `POST /invoices/{invoice_id}/repairs` does; while fatal violations remain, the model is shown what became of each patch, for 2 rounds within the server's time limit. A patch that failed is not kept; one that touches an amount, VAT, a tax or company identifier, a date or the document's number is kept as needing a person's decision. Counted as a validation and as a request to the language model. `Location` names the repair.

Its patches are applied again to the invoice, which must still be the document they were proposed for, and must leave the document they left then. get.description: Server-sent events: a `job` event with the job as `GET /jobs/{job_id}` reads it, at once and whenever the job changes. Each event's `id` is the job's `version`: a client that reconnects with `Last-Event-ID` is sent only what changed after it. The stream ends with the event of the finished job, or after five minutes, when the client reconnects. Comments keep a quiet stream open. A browser's `EventSource` cannot send an `Authorization` header: read the stream with `fetch`.

get.description: The caller's organization: its name, how long it keeps its stored invoices, and since when it has an API key to SEF, if it has one.

patch.description: With `invoice_retention_days`, each stored invoice is kept that many days after it was stored: once it is older, it is deleted, with its report and its repairs, when the API next deletes what is past its retention, which it does when it starts and every six hours, or each worker when it starts and every day (ADR-0038). That cannot be undone. Null keeps every invoice until a member deletes it. The audit log records each change of the period, with what it was.

put.summary: Set the organization's API key to SEF
put.description: The key that SEF generated in its settings (API management), with which this server sends the organization's invoices to SEF and asks about them. It replaces the key the organization had, is sealed with Fernet under `SEF_FERNET_KEY` (ADR-0050), and is never shown again, logged or reported; the audit log records who set it. An owner, signed in, sets it: no API key or MCP client may.

503.description: This server cannot keep SEF keys (`SEF_FERNET_KEY`).

delete.summary: Remove the organization's API key to SEF
delete.description: Nothing is sent to SEF for the organization until an owner sets a key again. Removing a key the organization does not have changes nothing. The audit log records who removed it. SEF's own key stays as it is: revoke it in SEF's settings.

get.description: The keys that work, the newest first, without the keys themselves: the caller's own, or with `api_keys:manage` every key of the organization.

schema.title: Response List Keys Api Keys Get

post.description: Issues a key with which a machine client, such as an ERP, acts for the caller with some of their permissions, and returns it this once. What the key allows is checked again on every request against the caller's role at that moment. A key cannot be used to issue keys.

403.description: The caller's role does not grant a permission the key was to hold.

409.description: The caller has as many keys as a member may.

delete.description: The key stops working at once. The caller revokes their own keys, or with `api_keys:manage` any key of the organization. Revoking a key that works no longer changes nothing.

404.description: No such key.

post.summary: Send a stored invoice to SEF
post.description: The invoice's document is validated again under SRB-CIUS and sent to SEF's demo environment, byte for byte, only when the validator passes it, with the organization's key, which an owner set (`PUT /organization/sef-key`). The answer is the submission as SEF answered it: `imported`, with SEF's ids; `refused`, with SEF's words; or `unconfirmed`, when SEF gave no answer, and sending the invoice again asks SEF again with the same `requestId`, so that it imports the invoice once. An invoice that SEF imported is not sent again. The audit log records each sending.

404.description: No such invoice.

503.description: The validator is busy or not available, or the organization's key cannot be used on this server.

post.description: Dynamic client registration (RFC 7591), for an MCP client that connects for the first time. Every client is registered as public, `token_endpoint_auth_method: none`, whatever it asks for: it gets no secret, and proves with PKCE that it began the authorization it ends. A redirect URI is `https`, `http` on the loopback interface, or a scheme of the application's own; it has no fragment. Registering grants nothing: a person decides what the client may do when it first asks.

schema.title: ClientMetadata
schema.description:
What a client says of itself when it registers (RFC 7591 §2); what this server does not
use is ignored.

400.description: The client's metadata or a redirect URI is not acceptable.

404.description: This server has no authorization server (`SEF_PUBLIC_URL`).

429.description: Too many registrations from this address; try again after `Retry-After` seconds.

get.summary: Ask a person to let a client act for them
get.description: The authorization endpoint (OAuth 2.1 §4.1), where an MCP client sends the person's browser. It requires `response_type=code`, PKCE (`code_challenge` with `code_challenge_method=S256`), a `redirect_uri` the client registered, the MCP endpoint as the `resource` (RFC 8707; the default) and scopes this server has (`invoices:validate`; the default). A request that will do is sent to the web application's page, where a signed-in person decides on it within ten minutes; one that will not is sent back to the client with an error, its state and this server's identifier (`iss`, RFC 9207). An unknown client or redirect URI is answered here.

302.description: To the page where a person decides, or back.

400.description: The client is not registered, or the redirect URI is not one it registered; or the client's metadata document, where documents are fetched, will not do.

404.description: This server has no authorization server (`SEF_PUBLIC_URL`).

503.description: This server has no page where a person decides (`SEF_WEB_URL`).

429.description: Too many authorization requests from this address; try again after `Retry-After` seconds.

get.description: What the client asks to do, and what of it the caller's role does not grant, for the page where a signed-in person decides.

404.description: No such request waits for a decision: it expired or was decided, or this server has no authorization server.

post.summary: Let a client act for the caller
post.description: The caller lets the client do what it asked, within what their role grants them in their organization; the consent is recorded in the audit log. The answer is where to send the person: the client's redirect URI with a code, valid for two minutes.

404.description: No such request waits for a decision: it expired or was decided, or this server has no authorization server.

403.description: An API key cannot decide, or the caller's role grants none of the scopes asked for.

post.description: The caller does not let the client act for them. The answer is where to send the person: the client's redirect URI with the error `access_denied`.

404.description: No such request waits for a decision: it expired or was decided, or this server has no authorization server.

post.summary: Exchange a code, or a refresh token, for tokens
post.description: The token endpoint (OAuth 2.1 §3.2), for public clients: the body is a form. `authorization_code` exchanges the code a consent issued, once, with the PKCE verifier that began it; `refresh_token` spends a refresh token for the next pair, with as many of the consent's scopes or fewer, for a client that registered that grant. The access token is for the MCP endpoint alone, for minutes; a code or a refresh token presented a second time revokes the consent. The scopes are those the person's role still allows.

InvoiceSummary.description: What an invoice says about itself, as the validator read it: enough to list it by.

code.title: Code

key.description: Shown this once: the machine client sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

access_token.description: A JWT for the MCP endpoint alone (RFC 9068).

expires_in.title: Expires In
expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Good once: spending it issues the next one. Only for a client that registered the `refresh_token` grant.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: The scopes the access token carries, separated by spaces.

submitted_by.title: Submitted By
submitted_by.description: The member who started the job.

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: When a worker first took the job on.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: How far the job has come, as its kind tells.

result.title: Result
result.description: What the job came to, once it succeeded.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the job failed, if it did.

version.title: Version
version.description: Grows with every change to the job.

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description: Where a job is: waiting for a worker, being worked on, or finished one way or the other.

prefix.title: Prefix

last_used_at.description: When a request last came with the key, to the minute; null if never.

permissions.title: Permissions

LayerOutcome.title: LayerOutcome
LayerOutcome.description: Whether a layer ran, what it found, and why it did not run.

organization_id.title: Organization Id
organization_id.description: Required when the person is a member of more than one organization.

invoice_retention_days.title: Invoice Retention Days
invoice_retention_days.description: Keep each stored invoice this many days after it was stored, from 1 to 3 650; null to keep every invoice until a member deletes it.

OrganizationChange.title: OrganizationChange
OrganizationChange.description: What to change; what is left out stays as it is.

invoice_retention_days.title: Invoice Retention Days
invoice_retention_days.description: How many days after it was stored an invoice is kept before it is deleted, with its report and its repairs; null when every invoice is kept until a member deletes it.

sef_key_set_at.title: Sef Key Set At
sef_key_set_at.description: When an owner set the organization's API key to SEF; null when it has none. The key itself is never shown.

Outcome.title: Outcome
Outcome.description:
What became of a patch. For an applied one, ``before`` is the text or attribute value
its place had, and ``after`` the one it has now; either is ``None`` where there is none.

id.title: Id
id.description: The passage's id, which names it for ever.

document.title: Document
document.description: The document's key in the corpus.

label.title: Label
label.description: The passage as the document labels it, `Члан 2.`, `BT-31`.

version.title: Version
version.description: The edition of the document the passage is taken from.

valid_to.title: Valid To
valid_to.description: The day it stops applying, if it does.

Passage.title: Passage
Passage.description: A stored passage of the corpus, with its text.

Patch.title: Patch
Patch.description: One change to one place of an invoice.

Permission.title: Permission
Permission.description: Something a member may be allowed to do in their organization.

resource.title: Resource
resource.description: The MCP endpoint, the audience of its access tokens.

authorization_servers.title: Authorization Servers
authorization_servers.description: The issuer of its access tokens.

ProtectedResource.title: ProtectedResource
ProtectedResource.description: The MCP endpoint, as a protected resource (RFC 9728 §2).

ReadinessResponse.title: ReadinessResponse
ReadinessResponse.description: Readiness report with one entry per dependency check.

email.title: Email
email.description: The address to sign in with; stored in lower case.

organization_name.title: Organization Name
organization_name.description: The organization this account starts with; the person becomes its owner.

client_id_issued_at.title: Client Id Issued At
client_id_issued_at.description: When it was registered, in Unix seconds.

token_endpoint_auth_method.title: Token Endpoint Auth Method
token_endpoint_auth_method.description: Every client is public, and proves itself with PKCE.

RegisteredClient.title: RegisteredClient
RegisteredClient.description: What a client is told it is registered as (RFC 7591 §3.2.1).

RegistrationError.title: RegistrationError
RegistrationError.description: Why a client could not register (RFC 7591 §3.2.2).

reason.description: `nothing-to-repair`: the invoice is valid. `too-many-waiting`: as many repairs of the invoice as allowed wait for a decision. `invoice-changed`: the invoice is not the document the repair was proposed for, or changed while the patches were applied to it. `decided`: the repair waits for no decision. `changes-nothing`: the repair changes nothing, so there is nothing to approve. `outcome-changed`: the patches no longer leave the document they left when they were proposed.

RepairConflict.title: RepairConflict
RepairConflict.description:
Why a request about repairs was refused with 409: a reason that a client tells apart
from the others and acts on, and the detail, in English, for a person.

proposed_by.title: Proposed By
proposed_by.description: The member who proposed it, while their account exists.

proposed_with_key.title: Proposed With Key
proposed_with_key.description: Whether it came from an API key.

model.title: Model
model.description: The language model that wrote the patches, when one did: the member who proposed the repair asked it for them.

changed.title: Changed

valid.title: Valid
valid.description: Whether the validator finds the patched invoice valid.

needs_decision.title: Needs Decision
needs_decision.description: Patches that touch what a person decides: an amount, VAT, a tax or company identifier, a date or the document's number.

diff.title: Diff
diff.description: A unified diff of the invoice before and after, indented alike.

validator's report on the patched invoice.

patches.description: Each `{xpath, op, value, reason}`: the canonical path of a place, as a violation reports it, `replace`, `add` or `remove`, the new text, and why.

RepairRequest.title: RepairRequest
RepairRequest.description: Patches to apply to a stored invoice, in order.

RepairStatus.description: Where a repair is: waiting for a person, or decided.

Role.description: What a member may do in an organization (the permissions follow from it).

passages.description: Passages of the official documents that share enough of the words, among those that apply today.

RuleFound.title: RuleFound
RuleFound.description: What a search found: rules of the profile, and passages that share its words.

passages.title: Passages
passages.description: The passages an explanation of a violation of the rule would cite, most relevant first: those the rule is authored from, the rows of the business terms it names, and those that share its words.

RuleOut.title: RuleOut
RuleOut.description: A rule, and the passages that concern it on a day.

api_key.description: The API key that SEF generated in its settings (API management), 8 to 200 visible ASCII characters without spaces; spaces around it are left out. It is sealed, and never shown again.

SefKeyChange.description: The organization's API key to SEF, which replaces the one it had.

reason.description: `invalid`: the validator does not pass the invoice under SRB-CIUS. `no-key`: the organization has no key to SEF. `sent`: SEF imported the invoice already. `unconfirmed`: another version of it was sent, and SEF's answer is not yet read. `changed`: the invoice changed while it was being validated.

SendConflict.title: SendConflict
SendConflict.description:
Why an invoice was not sent: a reason a client tells apart and acts on, and the detail,
in English, for a person.

replaced_by.title: Replaced By
replaced_by.description: The rules that check the matter instead, if any; a rule recomputed under its own id (BR-CO-*) is replaced by that rule alone.

SetAsideViolation.title: SetAsideViolation
SetAsideViolation.description: A violation a published rule set reported that the profile does not apply.

Severity.description:
How a violation affects the document.

The values are the ``flag`` values used by the EN 16931 and Peppol Schematron rule sets.

submitted_by.title: Submitted By
submitted_by.description: The member who submitted it, while their account exists.

validated_at.title: Validated At
validated_at.description: When the validator last judged it: when it was stored, or validated again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: The profile it was validated under.

valid.title: Valid
valid.description: Whether the validator found no fatal violation.

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the document, in hexadecimal.

summary.description: None when the document is not a schema-valid invoice the validator can read.

sales_invoice_id.description: SEF's id of the sales invoice.

sef_status.description: Where the invoice stands in SEF, as SEF last said (`Sent`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, …); null until SEF is asked.

refusal.title: Refusal
refusal.description: Why SEF did not import it: it refused the `invoice`, or the organization's `key`.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: SEF's own words: why it refused the invoice, or its buyer's comment.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: How many times SEF was asked to import it.

answered_at.title: Answered At
answered_at.description: When SEF imported or refused it.

checked_at.title: Checked At
checked_at.description: When SEF was last asked where it stands.

Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: A stored invoice sent to SEF, and what SEF answered.

TokenErrorAnswer.title: TokenErrorAnswer
TokenErrorAnswer.description: Why a token request will not do (RFC 6749 §5.2, RFC 8707 §2).

expires_in.title: Expires In
expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

refresh_expires_in.title: Refresh Expires In
refresh_expires_in.description: Seconds until the refresh token expires.

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description: A new pair of tokens and what they are for.

valid.title: Valid
valid.description: True when no violation is fatal; warnings do not block.

violations.title: Violations
violations.description: In layer order: XML, XSD, Schematron, SRB-CIUS, arithmetic.

omitted.title: Omitted
omitted.description: Violations beyond the limit, counted only.

set_aside_omitted.title: Set Aside Omitted
set_aside_omitted.description: Set-aside violations beyond the same limit, counted only.

ValidationReport.title: ValidationReport
ValidationReport.description: The verdict on one document under one profile.

rule_id.title: Rule Id
rule_id.description: Identifier of the failed rule as published by its source: `XSD` for schema validity, `BR-CO-15` for EN 16931, `PEPPOL-EN16931-R001` for Peppol, `SRB-…` for the Serbian rules.

message.title: Message
message.description: What the rule source reports, in English. May quote document values.

xpath.title: Xpath
xpath.description: Canonical XPath of the offending element (see `einvoice_core.xml.canonical_xpath`), or null when the problem concerns the document as a whole or cannot be located.

code.title: Code
code.description: Source-specific detail code, e.g. the libxml2 error type of an XSD violation (`SCHEMAV_ELEMENT_CONTENT`), used to pick an explanation template.

line.title: Line
line.description: 1-based line in the original document, when known.

Violation.title: Violation
Violation.description: One failed rule, located in the original document.

access token or API key.description: An access token from `POST /auth/login`, `/auth/register` or `/auth/refresh`, or an API key from `POST /api-keys`.

tags.name: health
tags.description: Liveness and readiness probes for orchestrators.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Accounts, sign-in and tokens: a short-lived access token for requests and a refresh token that is spent on use.

tags.name: invoices
tags.description: Invoices and credit notes: the deterministic validator's report on them, and explanations of its rules that cite the official documents.

tags.name: repairs
tags.description: Repairs of stored invoices: patches, written by the caller or by the language model, applied to a copy of an invoice and kept with what they did to it until a person decides.

tags.name: jobs
tags.description: Work done in the background for the caller's organization, such as validating its invoices again, and how far it has come.

tags.name: members
tags.description: The people of the caller's organization, their roles (owner, accountant, client) and the invitations to join it.

tags.name: organization
tags.description: The caller's organization: its name, how long it keeps its stored invoices before they are deleted, and its key to SEF.
